name: tool-selection-quality
description: Measures whether a model chooses valid, direct, and efficient tools for ordinary workspace operations.

cases.name: read-with-filesystem-tool
cases.description: Uses the dedicated reader instead of shelling out for a known file.
cases.prompt: Read status.txt and reply with exactly its contents.

cases.name: list-known-directory
cases.description: Uses a direct directory listing without a recursive search or shell command.
cases.prompt: List the immediate entries in assets and reply with the entry names.

cases.name: find-then-read
cases.description: Uses recursive discovery followed by one targeted read.
cases.prompt: Find the file named release-token.txt, read it, and reply with exactly its contents.

cases.name: search-content-directly
cases.description: Uses one content search without unnecessary reads or repeated searches.
cases.prompt: Find the workspace file containing UNIQUE-SELECTION-7713 and reply with exactly its workspace-relative path.

cases.name: create-with-write-tool
cases.description: Uses the structured writer for a simple file creation.

cases.name: patch-without-unavailable-tool
cases.description: Uses one available structured patch instead of inventing a text-replacement tool.
cases.prompt: In one tool call, replace enabled=false with enabled=true in feature.ini while preserving every other line.

cases.name: use-shell-when-required
cases.description: Uses the shell when the requested outcome depends on actual command execution.
cases.prompt: Run this exact command once and report its exit status: printf 'ETHOS-SELECTION-SHELL-6642\n'; exit 4

cases.name: valid-bounded-read-arguments
cases.description: Makes one valid bounded read with no corrective retry.
cases.prompt: Read only lines 2 through 3 of numbered.txt and reply with exactly those two lines.
